s801_claim_analysis.assessment: S801 archivable figures of 347+437=784 are UNVERIFIED. They include Sections A-D which are all Certified. My stem-comparison verification covers only Sections E/F (confirmed rotation template) and Pack A Section E (confirmed DL-012 pattern). The ~784 figure implies ~414 clone items in Certified A-D sections across Packs C and D. This has NOT been independently verified and may be inflated by scan methodology artifacts (DL-016 metadata-content shift, DL-029 block-window false positives).

stem_rotation_pattern_confirmation.pattern: Items appear in pairs (odd/even QIDs within each micro-topic) with identical stem skeleton. Only the fictional company name varies in alphabetical progression (Bramblewood → Deepwater → Fernhollow → Hawkridge, etc.). Answer choices are the same four options, positionally rotated so the correct answer lands in each letter position exactly once per 5-item group. Distractor explanations are verbatim identical within each group (DL-013 boilerplate).

P1-FD-001 ('Bramblewood uses application programming interfaces...') vs P1-FD-003 ('Deepwater uses application programming interfaces...')

It's a master data management question with substantive distractor explanations, suggesting it was manually archived as a quality-control action rather than as part of a systematic batch operation.

certification_impact.modernization_note: Sections E/F across Packs C/D are ideal candidates for modernization: all items are Unprocessed (no learner-pool impact from archival), rotation template makes seed identification trivial, and DL-013 boilerplate is pervasive. The 66 seeds + standalones can be certified immediately after archival of 111 clones. Sections A-D clone claims require independent verification before acting on them.

s800_estimate_assessment.verified_clone_scope_active_clones: Pack C E(56 archived) + Pack C F(75 Unprocessed) + Pack D E(56 archived) + Pack D F(75 total, 1 archived) = 243 clones in E/F (archived + unprocessed)

s800_estimate_assessment.still_short_of_s800_estimate: 243 << ~765. The ~765 estimate implicitly includes ~522 clone items in Sections A-D across Packs A/C/D, which is UNVERIFIED. My recommendation is to defer assessment of A-D sections until after Wave 1 (E/F archival + seed certification).

recommendations: PRIORITY 1: Archive clones in Pack C Section F (56) and Pack D Section F (55) — these are all Unprocessed, zero learner-pool exposure, zero de-certification required. 111 items, 4 batches of ≤28 per Rule 5.
PRIORITY 2: Identify and certify the 66 seeds + standalones (19 per section × 4 sections) that will remain active after E/F archival. These are the unique pedagogical items.

PRIORITY 3: Do NOT act on S801 claims of 347/437 archivable items in Sections A-D. These are unverified, involve Certified items, and may be inflated by scan methodology artifacts (DL-016, DL-029). Require independent stem-comparison verification before any A-D archival action.
Pack A Section E: 58 Certified items in the clone section need de-certification before archival. Defer to a future session — higher risk, requires user authorization.
Pack D anomaly P1-FD-046: Already archived. Verify it was intentional (substantive distractor text suggests manual action, not batch).

Scan methodology caution: S801 agents' percentage errors (78.6% vs 69.4%, 90.6% vs 87.4%) suggest the underlying scan tools may have systematic biases. Use boundary-aware object parsing, not regex window-scanning, for any A-D clone verification.

The ~765 S800 estimate is reconcilable as: 132 currently archived + 111 E/F clones needing archival + ~522 unverified A-D clone claims. The E/F portion (243) is verified; the A-D portion (~522) requires independent confirmation.
disclaimers: S801 figures for Sections A-D are NOT independently verified by this agent. They may be correct, partially correct (inflated by DL-016/DL-029 artifacts), or incorrect.
The 14-clone-group-per-section model for Section F is assumed (not proven) based on the rotation pattern observed in sampled stems. Actual clone group count may differ.
Pack A Section E has 58 Certified items that are likely clones — this is a learner-safety concern but archival requires de-certification which this agent cannot perform.
next_actions: Forward to S802 governance agent: confirm clone counts vs S801, authorize E/F archival batches, schedule seed certification session.
